title: L'appel nocturne de Fabrice  (Fabrice's Late-Night Call)

segments.t: On the line is an agitated and sleepless Fabrice Luchini, desperate to talk after discovering that his agent lost him the James Bond role. After agreeing to meet him immediately, Andréa rings Gabriel in triumph to celebrate the success of their cunning trap. Listen to the scene in French first. Don't worry about catching every word. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Allô? Fabrice?
Andréa, je ne dors pas.
Qu'est-ce qui ne va pas?
J'ai rencontré Debbie MacWilliams ce soir.
Bréhier a totalement raté le rôle.
Le rôle dans James Bond?
Oui! Je dois te voir maintenant.
D'accord, j'arrive tout de suite.
Gabriel, tu es réveillé?
Allô Andréa? Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
Fabrice vient de m'appeler!
C'est vrai? Le plan a marché!
Sois très douce avec lui.
Ne t'inquiète pas, je gère.
Tu es la meilleure, bonne chance!
Let's walk through the conversation step by step.
Allô? Fabrice?
'Hello? Fabrice?' Andrea answers her phone surprised by the late hour.
Andréa, je ne dors pas.
'Andréa, I cannot sleep.' Fabrice explains that his insomnia and racing thoughts kept him awake.
Qu'est-ce qui ne va pas?
'What is wrong?' Andrea asks what is troubling him so deeply.
J'ai rencontré Debbie MacWilliams ce soir.
'I met Debbie MacWilliams tonight.' Fabrice reveals his evening encounter with the purported British casting director.
Bréhier a totalement raté le rôle.
'Bréhier completely ruined the role.' Fabrice blames his long-time agent for squandering the opportunity.
Le rôle dans James Bond?
'The role in James Bond?' Andrea pretends to hear the news for the first time.
Oui! Je dois te voir maintenant.
'Yes! I must see you now.' Fabrice insists on meeting in person without waiting until morning.
D'accord, j'arrive tout de suite.
'All right, I am coming right away.' Andrea quickly agrees to come over immediately.
Gabriel, tu es réveillé?
'Gabriel, are you awake?' Andrea calls Gabriel to wake him and share the urgent news.
Allô Andréa? Qu'est-ce qui se passe?
'Hello Andréa? What is going on?' Gabriel answers groggily, wondering why she is calling at night.
Fabrice vient de m'appeler!
'Fabrice just called me!' Andrea triumphantly announces that Luchini took the bait.
C'est vrai? Le plan a marché!
'Is that true? The plan worked!' Gabriel is thrilled that their elaborate bluff paid off.
Sois très douce avec lui.
'Be very gentle with him.' Gabriel counsels her to approach the wounded star with care and tact.
Ne t'inquiète pas, je gère.
'Do not worry, I am handling it.' Andrea reassures him that she has the situation completely under control.
Tu es la meilleure, bonne chance!
'You are the best, good luck!' Gabriel cheers her on before she sets off into the night. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

With Fabrice completely hooked by their deception, Andréa rushes out to comfort the star and seal the deal. Listen to the scene once more to solidify your French conversational skills. See you next time!
À bientôt!
